title: A Crown for the Ember
author: Isandro Reyes
blurb: Ada Delacroix, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the long winter finishes falling.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
